prompt: I need to upgrade our context7 score from 30 to 75 by making the llms-pde.txt a proper reference with implementation guidance drawn from miaco and miadi lineages. The score measures structured thinking organization and right now we are weak on practical examples and navigable cross-linking.

secondary.target: llms-pde.txt to be a proper reference
implementation guidance from miaco and miadi lineages
navigable cross-linking (TOC, anchors, index) between llms-pde.txt and lineage docs

secondary.dependency: all content and linking updates applied

secondary.target: pull request and review workflow for the updates

assumptions: miaco and miadi lineages contain usable implementation guidance
Improving structure, examples and cross-links in llms-pde.txt will raise the context7 score
The repo owner accepts PRs and documented changes
A reproducible context7 scoring method (API/CLI) is available

communications: Create PR updating llms-pde.txt with examples and cross-links
Open issue tracking 'Raise context7 score to 75' and link reviewers
Add commit message and Co-authored-by trailer

east.text: Make llms-pde.txt the canonical, implementation-focused reference that demonstrates structured thinking with practical examples and clear navigation
Define acceptance criteria for context7 score = 75 (which metrics or tests must pass)

south.text: Inventory and extract implementation patterns from miaco and miadi lineage documents
Identify concrete examples and minimal reproducible implementations to include

west.text: Run context7 scoring after edits and collect reviewer feedback to validate improvements
Peer review PR to ensure examples are practical and cross-links are navigable

north.text: Edit llms-pde.txt: add implementation guidance, examples, anchor links, and TOC; commit and open PR
Iterate based on scoring and reviewer comments until context7 score ≥ 75
